critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /predictions/log uses (corr_count > 0 and corr_count % 10 == 0) to trigger recalc — correct behaviour for 10th/20th/... corrections. Works as designed.
_recalc_personal_thresholds tolerance heuristic uses max deviation bounded to [10,45] — fine for MVP but consider stddev for tighter bands once dataset grows.

BiomechCoaching summary uses len(preds) (biomech predictions for this session) for averages but len(shots) for balls — slight inconsistency if user logged manual shots but no predictions. Currently OK because summary['balls'] reflects shots logged. Worth a comment in code.
Dashboard.jsx: TID.uploadVideoBtn/liveCameraBtn fall through to navigate('/pricing') for free users via onClick branch — confirmed working. Good.
LiveCamera/VideoAnalyzer correctly lazy-load TF.js via /lib/poseDetector.js — bundle stays light for non-pro browsers (not directly tested in headless, but module structure is sound).
No 'run-1' data-testid exists; the runs row uses generic numbered buttons (1,2,3,...). If automation requires per-runs testids, add data-testid={`run-${n}`} for stability.

test_credentials.note: Seeded via mongosh into test_database.users + test_database.user_sessions, 7-day expiry. Pro user accumulated 14 prediction logs across tests (10 corrections + 4 correct), so AI accuracy badge reads 28.6%.

context_for_next_testing_agent: For future iterations, reuse the seeded tokens above (or seed fresh per /app/auth_testing.md). Biomech tests assume base_corrections==0 for the Pro user when verifying the 9th-no-recalc/10th-recalc boundary; if reusing the same Pro user across runs, that branch is skipped gracefully (only the count delta is asserted). Frontend live-camera and video-frame analysis cannot be fully exercised in headless Playwright (no WebGL/camera) — verifying that the modals open with their first interactive testid is the right surface check.
